source_claim: AlphaEvolve can optimize multiple user-provided scores, so multi-objective tradeoffs should be part of the durable archive policy rather than only diagnostic views
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve manifests and archive snapshots include diagnostic objective frontiers, declared normalized metric vectors, bounded Pareto frontier retention, metric-cell archive overlays, metric/frontier sampling pools, objective archive policy snapshots, and readiness overclaim rejection. It does not claim primary Pareto archive replacement, frontier-dominance cell replacement, durable cross-run metric databases, metric-target persistence tables, LLM feedback calibration runners, cross-run metric-specific optimization, or frontier primary archive replay.
